description_en: Adds a route entry to a network instance by calling the CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen operation
description_zh: 调用CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen接口为网络实例添加路由条目
kebab_example: aliyun cbn create-cen-child-instance-route-entry-to-cen --cen-id cen-7febra5nqj7jjh0000 --child-instance-id vpc-k1alm2jbuwibhxtx20000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id ap-southeast-5 --route-table-id vtb-k1aa8ulqs39f86op80000 --destination-cidr-block 192.168.22.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCenChildInstanceRouteEntryToCen

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: a virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.
VBR: a virtual border router (VBR) instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例类型。取值：

VPC：表示专有网络实例。
VBR：表示边界路由器实例
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the network instance belongs.

This parameter is required if the network instance belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID。

如果您当前的网络实例为跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填
parameters.name: child_instance_ali_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table of the network instance
parameters.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination CIDR block of the route entry.

The destination CIDR block must be in CIDR format. Example: 192.168.10.0/24
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目的目标网段。

目标网段为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.10.0/24
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block
